description: Integration (extend 'sync_updates mirrors public comments to children' in server/src/test/integration/ticketBundling.integration.test.ts): after addTicketCommentWithCache on the master, the child row has user_id/author_type equal to the source, thread created_by equals the author, is_system_generated is true, the mirrors row links child→source, resolveCommentAuthor(child, getTicketDetails(child).userMap) yields the agent's display name, updateComment on the child is still rejected, and the mocked publishEvent fired exactly once (master ticket only)
Integration: mirroring a source comment that carries contact_id copies contact_id onto the child row (author resolves through contactMap)

Integration (DB-backed): backfill migration — seed a master comment, a legacy child copy with null user_id/contact_id/author_type 'unknown' and null thread created_by plus its ticket_bundle_mirrors row, and one non-mirrored null-author comment; run up(): child row and thread are filled from the source, the unrelated comment is untouched; rerun up() is a no-op; down() restores the child row and thread to null/'unknown'

Notification integration (server/src/test/integration/ticketBundlingEmailFanout.integration.test.ts): seed master + child with mirrored child comment rows that carry the agent's user_id and mirrors links, dispatch TICKET_COMMENT_ADDED for the master; the child email goes to the child requester, entityType/entityId are the child ticket, replyContext.ticketId is the child, commentSource is {master ticket, master comment}, context.comment.author names the agent, and no email is sent to the agent or duplicated per child

Unit (packages/tickets, vitest + RTL): CommentItem with is_system_generated and a resolvable user renders the author name, real avatar, and a 'Bundled update' badge; with bundleMaster the badge is an anchor to /msp/tickets/{id}; without bundleMaster it is a plain badge; with an unresolvable author it falls back to label-as-name with the placeholder avatar; a non-mirrored comment shows no badge
Integration (portal): getClientTicketDetails on the child ticket returns the mirrored comment with the agent present in userMap so the portal resolves the author

Guard: after mirroring with an author, the child ticket's response state / reopen logic is not triggered (child status and response-state columns unchanged), proving readers key on is_system_generated rather than a populated user_id
